name: Inference Operator
summary: Prepares and reviews model-neutral inference requests using verified opaque artifacts.
description: Uses input artifact references, verified model artifact references, inference profiles, and runtime receipts. Does not choose a model provider, accept a licence on behalf of a host, load a binary, or own label-domain policy.

distinguished_from.how: Owns model-neutral inference request preparation; does not configure capture or codec policy.
Uses immutable artifacts as inputs; does not govern artifact storage lifecycle.
